28	func (h *handler) getEntryFromBuilder(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, b *storage.EntryQueryBuilder) {
29		entry, err := b.GetEntry()
30		if err != nil {
31			response.JSONServerError(w, r, err)
32			return
33		}
34	
35		if entry == nil {
36			response.JSONNotFound(w, r)
37			return
38		}
39	
40		entry.Content = mediaproxy.RewriteDocumentWithAbsoluteProxyURL(entry.Content)
41		entry.Enclosures.ProxifyEnclosureURL(config.Opts.MediaProxyMode(), config.Opts.MediaProxyResourceTypes())
42	
43		response.JSON(w, r, entry)
44	}

48		feedID := request.RouteInt64Param(r, "feedID")
49		if feedID == 0 {
50			response.JSONBadRequest(w, r, errors.New("invalid feed ID"))
51			return
52		}
53	
54		entryID := request.RouteInt64Param(r, "entryID")
55		if entryID == 0 {
56			response.JSONBadRequest(w, r, errors.New("invalid entry ID"))
57			return
58		}
59	
60		builder := h.store.NewEntryQueryBuilder(request.UserID(r)).
61			WithFeedID(feedID).
62			WithEntryIDs(entryID)
63	
64		h.getEntryFromBuilder(w, r, builder)
